jobs.title: Sand Grain Hits Earth at Light Speed
jobs.description:
What if one tiny grain of sand hit Earth close to the speed of light? At 99% of light speed it hits like 130 tons of TNT - and just 300 m/s slower than light, like an atomic bomb. At exactly light speed, the energy would be infinite!

#space #physics #whatif #science #shorts
